subject: strange error message using "ordered" for binary data

messages.author: 7f276f116ec4bd60
messages.subject: strange error message using "ordered" for binary data
parts:
Hello,

I just tried to use a two years old lavaan-script, but it doesn't function anymore:


modell.subtrakt.k2.rasch <- 'subtrakt2 =~ 1*cM_20a + 1*cM_20g + 1*cM_200a + 1*cM_200b + 1*cM_20h + 1*cM_200c + 1*cM_200d + 1*cM_200e'          

subtrakt.k2.rasch <- cfa(modell.subtrakt.k2.rasch, data = datenneu,meanstructure=TRUE, ordered=c("cM_20a","cM_20g","cM_200a","cM_200b","cM_20h","cM_200c","cM_200d","cM_200e"))


All I get is the following error-message:

Error in get(name, envir = asNamespace(pkg), inherits = FALSE) : 
  object '.setDummyField' not found

The same happens if I declare the variables as ordered in the dataset before. If I don't declare them as ordered in any way, everything works.
The variables are binary and as I told before two years ago the script functioned with the same dataset ...

I really don't understand this error!

Does anyone have any idea about this?

Edgar

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: strange error message using "ordered" for binary data

On 7/2/2015 3:31 PM, edgars...@web.de wrote:
> Error in get(name, envir = asNamespace(pkg), inherits = FALSE) :
> object '.setDummyField' not found

I have never seen this before. It is not a lavaan-specific error (but an
generic R error). I would re-install R (use the latest version), and
re-install lavaan. If the problem persists, please send me a
reproducible example, and I will further investigate.

Yves.

Working with R3.0.0 seems to be the reason! Using a later version of R the script functions!

Edgar
